name: Yayoi
source:
Likes: Cherry Blossoms, Roses
Dislikes: Countryside, Brother
Hobby: Reading, Classical Music
Home: Spring Village

A noble samurai who is haunted by his dark past

Yayoi is the candidate for the next Spring Village chieftain.
His ancestor is Soma, the Wind Village ninja.
You and Yayoi have been close since childhood including Ayu, whom Yayoi has taken care of.
His hardworking attitude gains everyone's trust that he is expected to play an important role for the growth of the Spring Village.

Though he is known for his kind nature, he is severely allergic to those who are from rural areas, which prevents him from developing a healthy relationship with Kaito, Shiroya, Ran, and Fuyukiku.

His dark past is revealed when his long lost brother suddenly appears.

[From in-game profile (Season 1)]
